# AccSolis

> AccSolis is an accounting and audit firm in Thailand with more than 20 years of experience. It provides bookkeeping, tax filing, year-end financial statements, financial statement audit and analysis, accounting system setup, and advisory for companies promoted by Thailand's Board of Investment (BOI). AccSolis serves clients in every province of Thailand online and is a certified service partner of FlowAccount. Tagline: "Illuminate Your Business Decisions."

AccSolis (สำนักงานบัญชีและตรวจสอบบัญชี) เป็นสำนักงานบัญชีและตรวจสอบบัญชีในประเทศไทย ประสบการณ์กว่า 20 ปี ให้บริการจัดทำบัญชี ยื่นภาษี ปิดงบการเงิน ตรวจสอบงบการเงิน วางระบบบัญชี และที่ปรึกษากิจการ BOI ทั่วประเทศ พันธมิตรผู้ให้บริการ FlowAccount

## Key facts

- Name: AccSolis
- Legal entity: AccSolis Co., Ltd.
- Type: Accounting, audit and business advisory firm (สำนักงานบัญชี ตรวจสอบบัญชี และที่ปรึกษาธุรกิจ)
- Experience: more than 20 years
- Service area: all of Thailand, every province (served online; not limited to Bangkok)
- Languages: Thai, English
- Accounting platform: FlowAccount (certified service partner)
- Pricing: quoted per client based on business type, document volume and scope; initial consultation is free
- Website: https://accsolis.co.th/ (Thai, default) and https://accsolis.co.th/en/ (English)
- Email: info@accsolis.co.th
- LINE Official Account: https://lin.ee/8GuuAe8
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100094755125575

## Philosophy: "Illuminate Your Business Decisions" (ส่องสว่างทุกการตัดสินใจทางธุรกิจ)

The sun in the AccSolis logo stands for making financial figures clear enough that management can see the true position of the business and decide with confidence. Accounting does not end with closing the books or filing taxes; it ends with information the client can use to steer the business. Three pillars:

- Clarity (ความชัดเจน): accurate, complete, up-to-date books showing revenue, costs and cash flow as they really are.
- Insight (ความเข้าใจ): financial analysis that surfaces trends, risks and opportunities before they become problems.
- Confidence (ความมั่นใจ): practical advice for planning and decisions, grounded in legal compliance and professional standards.

## Services

- Accounting & Tax (บริการบัญชีและภาษี): monthly bookkeeping; VAT returns (P.P.30 / ภ.พ.30); withholding tax returns (P.N.D.1, 3, 53 / ภ.ง.ด.1, 3, 53); payroll and social security; year-end financial statements.
- Financial Statement Audit & Analysis (ตรวจสอบและวิเคราะห์งบการเงิน): annual financial statement audit; analysis of performance and financial position; management summary reports.
- Advisory & Accounting Systems (ที่ปรึกษาและวางระบบบัญชี): company registration; accounting and document system design; FlowAccount online accounting setup; tax advisory.
- BOI Accounting & Advisory (บัญชีและที่ปรึกษากิจการ BOI): separate accounts for BOI and non-BOI activities; reporting under BOI promotion conditions; compliance advice for promotion certificates.

## How engagement works

1. Initial consultation (free): understand the business, document volume and needs.
2. Scope proposal: assess the scope of work and propose the working model.
3. Setup and delivery: configure online accounting, monthly bookkeeping, tax filing, document management.
4. Reporting and advice: financial statement summaries, accuracy checks, ongoing advice.
